text:
The MGAP national forest cartography (2021 version) is the source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest. It maps 13.1 ha of the event area as native forest, 0.4 ha as outside mapped forest, and 0.0 ha as planted forest.

The other two sources don't make that distinction. Hansen GFC identifies the 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025 (3.91% of the asset). JRC GFC2020 shows that 98% of the event area was forest in 2020, but it doesn't say what type.

The MGAP map dates from 2021, so it describes forest type as of that year, not 2025.
